identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b3.1d] Stream authenticated continuity bundles between voters

values.goal: Move one real #208 continuity bundle between the exact authorized source and target voters with bounded resumable authenticated streaming.
values.required_outcome: A closed typed service on the existing authenticated polis connection streams and incrementally verifies exact bundle bytes into the target's isolated #208 stage, survives partition/restart/reply loss, and aborts with live zero-residue proof without generic transport or whole-bundle allocation.
declared_scope: Opaque #201 transfer authority bound to exact source, target, route cut, lineage, bundle, deadline, and limits
Closed typed continuity-transfer service on #191 authenticated current-voter sessions
Bounded canonical frames, backpressure, accepted-prefix durability, resume, replay, and conflict handling
Incremental SnapshotCatalog and whole-content verification without whole-bundle allocation
Opaque #208 source-bundle reader and target isolated-stage writer integration
Exact abort, cleanup, zero-residue, crash, restart, rollback, path, and evidence proof
authority_boundary: Only #201's private finalized ContinuityTransferGrantProjection plus the current #191 authenticated route and #203 certificate cut creates a transfer session; callers cannot construct or widen the projection

The projection and session bind exact domain, polis, operation/transfer ids, lineage, source/target voter and Guardian, route/membership/certificate/boot cuts, signed bundle/catalog bytes and digests, trusted key generation, canonical entries/chunks/ranges, bounds, deadline, uncertainty policy, and cleanup identity

#210 consumes only #208's sealed ContinuityBundleSourcePort and TargetContinuityEffectPort and never receives a caller path, raw file handle, injectable normal-build trait, synthetic bundle, or caller-selected expected descriptor

Before every write #210 and #208 independently match signature/key generation, entry order/schema/range/length/digest, chunk index/range/digest/predecessor, frame and whole-bundle bounds; mismatch fails before durable bytes, verifier state, or prefix changes

TargetCleanupPermit is a separate #208-owned discard-only authority bound to the exact stage and remains valid after transfer deadline expiry or cancellation until TargetDiscardReceipt or TargetActivationReceipt
#210 may request #208 cleanup after an authorized transfer abort but performs no deletion itself; only #208 touches kernel/filesystem state and attests live zero residue

Transfer completion returns only VerifiedTransferPossession containing exact TargetStageHandle and TargetPossessionEvidence; it creates no fencing, activation, OwnerCommit, ownership, serving, or cloud authority
#204 alone owns migration/control decisions and invokes #208 source resume, target activation, or target discard through its private adapter
The transfer capability has no generic send API and cannot dispatch Raft, unknown, public, or ordinary polis messages
Normal builds expose no injectable mock transport, verifier, bundle reader, stage writer, cleanup authority, or possession constructor

Do not bind #210 or edit product source until issue #202 is independently reviewed, merged, and ancestral, then issue #199 is independently reviewed, merged, and ancestral, then issue #203 is independently reviewed, merged, and ancestral
After #202, #199, and #203 merge in that order, resync #210 onto the resulting exact origin/main and rerun typed csdlc-validate issue plus csdlc-doctor before bind

Resolve every review finding through a subagent and obtain fresh exact-head review before publication
Open a ready PR for visibility but never merge before operator review and authorization
No AWS use and no lifecycle closeout
